steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each target and priority is matched to its result and its owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 target missed by more than 10 percent

findings.title: Target missed by more than 10 percent
findings.fix: Set the recovery action for the quarter

pros: Checks a target missed by more than 10 percent; a channel with no review in the quarter; a next-quarter priority with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Market conditions; competitor activity.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-quarterly-review skill on the records for this review.
